reader.notes: PresentLine sets LINE-COUNTER to each line's target before composing, so the last line leaves it there; BeginGroup returns before any presentation for a group with no present line or a SUPPRESS, so LINE-COUNTER is untouched. Classes a, d, e, f do not apply.
